doc.intent: The production preset is a neutral two-panel LCD treatment without CRT scanlines.
doc.activation: The source-built Azahar package reports separate 400x240 and 320x240 ABI2 game surfaces. The generic Semu tap applies this neutral LCD preset to those surfaces before composing the selected shell.
doc.screens: the top screen uses the lcd1x grid; the bottom screen sits at a fractional scale in the shell's touch-screen opening (0.95x on the Deck), where a one-sine-per-pixel grid beats into bands, so it gets the panel's mean light without a grid
